text:
The schedule is unique, and I checked it against all 15 constraints.

- Ann comes right after Elif and after Ivo, so Elif is after Ivo. Elif must be at least 3 slots from Ivo (Hana+1), so Elif is at least Hana+4. Ann is then at least Hana+5, so Hana is at most 4.
- Gus is before Ivo and exactly one person sits between Gus and Hana. Gus can't be at Hana+2, because that is after Ivo. So Gus is at Hana−2, and Hana is at least 3.
- The team note says Elif and Ann must take slots 8 and 9. The distance rules alone don't force that. Elif could also be 7 with Ann 8 (Hana 3), but that case fails on the Dev and Ben/Finn constraints below.
- Hana = 4 gives Gus 2, Ivo 5, Elif 8, Ann 9. Ben and Finn need consecutive free slots, and the only pair left is 6 and 7. That leaves no slot for Dev, who must come after Hana and before Finn. This case fails.
- Hana = 3 gives Gus 1 and Ivo 4.
  - Elif 7 and Ann 8 leave Ben and Finn only slots 5 and 6, so Dev has no slot. This fails.
  - Elif 8 and Ann 9 leave slots 2, 5, 6 and 7.
    - Ben 5 and Finn 6 leave no slot for Dev. This fails.
    - Ben 6 and Finn 7 put Dev at 5 and Cara at 2. Ben and Cara are 4 apart, and Cara and Elif are 6 apart. All constraints hold.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Cara","3":"Hana","4":"Ivo","5":"Dev","6":"Ben","7":"Finn","8":"Elif","9":"Ann"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
